scripts.dev: npm run build && npm --workspace @livelocale/demo run dev
scripts.build: npm --workspace @livelocale/core run build && npm --workspace @livelocale/browser run build && npm --workspace @livelocale/react run build && npm --workspace @livelocale/transformers-provider run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build && node tests/core-smoke.mjs && node tests/browser-smoke.mjs
